title: Aura Spectral Asset Library v0.1
world_identity: Perpetual temperate homeostasis maintained by a luminous prismatic atmosphere
Life absorbs pure spectral energy from wavelengths rather than hunting or conventional photosynthesis
Plants change color in response to absorbed atmospheric energy frequencies
Floating creatures redistribute excess color-energy and stabilize ecosystem balance
Subterranean crystal caves act as memory chambers where crystal geometry refracts light into mathematical patterns
texture_spec: All maps are 2048x2048 (2K). Each PBR material set contains albedo, roughness, tangent-space normal, height and ambient occlusion.

limitations: GLB geometry is a procedural modular starter set, not final sculpted cinematic hero assets.
PBR maps are delivered separately and need assignment to materials in Blender, Unreal or Unity.
Fauna and flora have no baked animation clips; their geometry is prepared for later rigging and shader-driven spectral color animation.
